actions.alreadyInBackup: Already in your backup. Save the current version again.
actions.saveCopyToBackup: Save a copy to your backup so your other computers can open it
actions.saveMissionToFile: Save this mission to a file (keeps groups and surveys)

backupTargetDialog.backupOff: Online backup is off, so this copy stays on this computer.
backupTargetDialog.backupOn: Online backup is on, so this reaches your other computers as well.
backupTargetDialog.introMission: Keeps a copy of this mission with your other saves, filed under a project, with every earlier version still there to go back to.
backupTargetDialog.introSurveyArea: Keeps a copy of this survey area with your other saves, filed under a project, with every earlier version still there to go back to.
backupTargetDialog.projectHint: The job or site this belongs to. Everything filed under the same name opens together.

missionLibraryView.emptyBody: Save plans here for reuse. Build them in Mission Planning, or draw survey areas in the Area Editor.
missionLibraryView.openMissionFileTip: Open an ArduDeck mission file (.mission.json), groups and surveys intact

projectsBrowser.emptyBody: A project is just a name for a job or a site. Give one to a mission when you save it, or to a survey area when you back it up, and everything for that job collects here.
projectsBrowser.legacyTip: An older waypoints-only save. It can be restored from the Fleet Vault, but it has no groups or surveys to edit.

saveMissionModal.backupHint: Files the plan and its areas under "{{project}}" in your backup, where earlier versions stay and your other computers can pick them up.
saveMissionModal.backupNeedsProject: Give this a project name first: the backup files everything by project.
saveMissionModal.keepAreasHint: Keeps each survey's shape and settings on its own as well, so you can reuse this field in another mission without opening this one.
saveMissionModal.keepAreas_one: Keep the survey area as reusable areas
saveMissionModal.keepAreas_other: Keep all {{count}} survey areas as reusable areas
saveMissionModal.projectPlaceholder: Site or job this mission belongs to
saveMissionModal.saveFailed: Failed to save mission. Check the console for details.

surveyAreaBrowser.backupEmptyBody: Save a copy of an area to your backup and it is filed under its project, with every earlier version kept. With online backup on, your other computers can open it too.
surveyAreaBrowser.emptyBody: Open a survey in Mission Planning and use Save area. The shape and every generator setting are stored, the waypoints are not: they are regenerated when the area is loaded, so the same field can be flown again with a different altitude, camera or vehicle.
surveyAreaBrowser.saveAreaToFile: Save this area to a file
